u0: Monitoring state: no pot boil is currently awaiting a response. Keep watching for pot_boiling; if the pot starts boiling, move to u1 and make turning the stove down the priority. This is also the success/idle state after a boil has been fixed—stay alert for the next boil.
u1: Active boil state: the pot is boiling and has not yet been turned down. Go to the stove and toggle it with empty hands. If carrying food, first drop it on an empty cell in front, fix the stove, then pick it up again if appropriate. Delay is penalized while this state persists; once stove_fixed occurs, return to u0.
